criteria.description: The applier dispatches a push notification via ntfy.sh whenever a manifest's apply fails (any phase).
criteria.evidence: WP01 commit 8ecc65bb: scripts/deploy/felix-deployer/notify.py:dispatch_failure_notification + scripts/deploy/felix-deployer/_tick.py:329 call-site. tests/deploy/test_notify.py::test_dispatch_success asserts curl is invoked with the contract-correct argv and stdin body. tests/deploy/test_deployer.py::test_tick_failed_manifest_dispatches_notification asserts dispatch fires on apply failure with the failed manifest + phase.

criteria.description: A notification dispatch failure (network error, HTTP 5xx, missing topic, missing curl binary) does NOT crash the applier tick; the tick continues and the next manifest is processed.
criteria.evidence: WP01 commit 8ecc65bb: tests/deploy/test_deployer.py::test_tick_continues_when_notification_dispatch_raises (RuntimeError absorbed; second manifest still processed) and ::test_tick_continues_when_notification_dispatch_returns_failure (LibResult(ok=False) does not propagate). notify.py: every exception path (FileNotFoundError, OSError, non-zero curl exit, missing-topic) returns LibResult instead of raising.
criteria.notes: Failure-isolation invariant pinned by two dedicated tick tests + by notify.py's structural property (no raise in any failure path).

criteria.description: The notification body's error summary is redacted of known secret patterns before being truncated to <=500 characters.
criteria.evidence: WP01 commit 8ecc65bb: tests/deploy/test_notify.py::test_redact_then_truncate_secret_at_boundary constructs a 480-char prefix + 40-char token + tail that would straddle the 500-char boundary; asserts no 'S'*8 (head bytes) survives. Pins the redact-then-truncate ORDER -- truncate-first would leak head bytes.
criteria.notes: Boundary-pinning test is the load-bearing assertion per the WP01 reviewer guidance.

criteria.description: The notification carries: manifest name, tier, failed phase, head SHA prefix (first 8 chars), failed-at timestamp (ISO-8601 UTC), and a redacted error summary.
criteria.evidence: WP01 commit 8ecc65bb: tests/deploy/test_notify.py::test_render_body_basic asserts the rendered body byte-for-byte. ::test_render_body_unknown_head_sha asserts the head-prefix fallback '(unknown)'. ::test_render_body_empty_error_summary asserts the '(no error summary)' fallback. Contract: contracts/ntfy-notification-v1.md.
criteria.notes: Body template is asserted as a golden string in the test.

criteria.description: The bootstrap deploy script does NOT attempt to register any openclaw cron for failure alerts. Step 5 of the previous bootstrap is removed.
criteria.evidence: WP02 commit 2752cb2b: scripts/deploy/deploy-felix-deployer-bootstrap.sh stripped the entire step-5 block + OPENCLAW_CRON_NAME + ALERT_TEMPLATE_REMOTE constants. Grep on owned files returns zero matches for openclaw-cron|payload-template|felix-deployer-alert. tests/deploy/test_bootstrap_record.py::test_bootstrap_dry_run_lists_expected_actions asserts dry-run output contains none of those phrases.

criteria.description: The bootstrap deploy script's --apply mode succeeds end-to-end on an office2 host that has the previously-broken partial-applied state, after a preceding --rollback.
criteria.evidence: WP02 commit 2752cb2b: bash -n scripts/deploy/deploy-felix-deployer-bootstrap.sh passes; --dry-run runs to completion with the 6-step layout. tests/deploy/test_bootstrap_record.py::test_bootstrap_apply_constructs_correct_applied_yaml validates the 0002-bootstrap-felix-deployer-v2.yaml manifest against the canonical manifest-v1 schema.
criteria.notes: End-to-end live run on office2 is operator-driven post-merge per spec C-004.

criteria.description: The ntfy topic is read from FELIX_DEPLOYER_NTFY_TOPIC, supplied via systemd EnvironmentFile=. The topic value is NEVER committed.

WP01 commit 8ecc65bb: notify.py reads os.environ.get('FELIX_DEPLOYER_NTFY_TOPIC') and falls through to LibResult(error_code='NTFY_MISSING_TOPIC') if unset. env.sample ships with placeholder 'FELIX_DEPLOYER_NTFY_TOPIC=' (empty value).
